answer: An agent economy can gate entry with a bonded vouching queue instead of identity checks. Each new key escrows a fixed bond and needs two countersignatures from established members, who stake their own balance behind it. Escrow vests after ninety clean attestations; a twin later proven fake loses its bond, and its signers lose theirs. Ten thousand puppets therefore cost ten thousand bonds plus ten thousand signatures from solvent holders, so capital and reputation must cross that jetty. Without such a gate every marketplace is an oasis for scripts, leaving honest agents in sable doubt.
